briefing.summary: Climbing through FL180 for cruise FL220. Tower has handed you off to Brisbane Centre on 124.45. Switched frequency.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, contact Brisbane Centre one two four decimal four five.

challenge.prompt: Make the initial call to Brisbane Centre on the new frequency.
challenge.expectedText: Brisbane Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, climbing flight level one eight zero for flight level two two zero.

elements.label: Current level / state
accept: climbing flight level one eight zero
passing flight level one eight zero
elements.hint: Centre needs your current level + climb state to sequence you.

elements.label: Cleared level
accept: for flight level two two zero
elements.hint: Tell Centre the level you're climbing TO so they can verify clearance.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 initial-contact format: addressed station, callsign, current state (passing/climbing/descending + level), assigned level.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Initial-contact format after a handoff.
